question: What is the meaning of life cycle assessment (lca) environmental in relation to chemical properties?
description: Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) environmental analysis focuses on evaluating the potential environmental impacts of a product system throughout its life cycle. In relation to chemical properties, this analysis specifically examines eco-toxicological impacts, which include the effects of chemicals on human health and the environment. However, due to the lack of broad consensus and harmonization in the LCA community, there is no clear guidance on how to achieve this in practice, leading many LCA practitioners to exclude toxicity-related impacts from their assessments.
